applyTo: "**/requirements.md"
---

# Requirements Artifact Instructions
- Keep requirements traceable to Confluence page/story IDs.
- Distinguish confirmed requirements, human-approved decisions, assumptions, recommendations, and open questions.
- Use testable acceptance criteria; use Given/When/Then where it clarifies behavior.
- Preserve business wording unless a human approves a change.
- Do not fabricate measurable NFR targets, policy, retention periods, roles, or workflow states.
- Mark status clearly: DRAFT, AWAITING CLARIFICATION, APPROVED, or SUPERSEDED.
- Include a source coverage checklist and list unreadable/unavailable pages.
